page.content:
Fortified home of the Aesir, reached by the Bifrost.

How Asgard connects

  • Faction: Aesir — Asgard is the fortified home of the Aesir.
  • Location: Valhalla — Valhalla stands in Asgard as Odin's hall of the slain.
  • Location: Yggdrasil — Asgard is one of the worlds held in Yggdrasil.
  • Location: Bifrost — Bifrost joins Asgard to Midgard.

What is Asgard?

Asgard is the gods' enclosure: Valhalla, Odin's high seat, and the halls of Thor and the other Aesir, linked to Midgard by the rainbow bridge.

Key threads lead to Aesir, Valhalla, Yggdrasil and Bifrost.
